reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and isDailyWeekendSkip machinery and adds one shared isWeekendOrHoliday predicate that every former d.isWeekend check now calls.

duplication.why: The holiday rule is defined once, but the change edits the already-parallel skip/move filter+map pipelines in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange in lockstep instead of consolidating them, and threads holidays by hand at five call sites.

placement.why: Holiday detection and moving live in shared/schedules.ts with the weekend rule; the server callers only pass config data.

scope.why: Only the schedule date path, the recur data plumbing and the type change.

maintainability.why: Clear single definitions of non-working day and of the move; the remaining per-caller skip/move dispatch and the margin heuristic are pre-existing patterns lightly extended.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend checks were switched to isWeekendOrHoliday and all moves still go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: No new logic is copied; the parallel pipelines in server/schedules/app.ts pre-date the change.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts isWeekendOrHoliday (used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and inside getDateWithSkippedWeekend, which schedule-template also calls).
